checks: Existing admin session opens without a signature; collection and NFT metadata remain text-safe.
Catalog selections preserve full database identity and large onchain IDs; two selected pieces become two distribution rows.
Repeated CSV pieces and pieces already in the distribution queue are rejected before any request or signature.
NFT details preserve large invoice IDs; optional names, individual royalties and arbitrary attribute rows save through the protected API.
Two selected images are counted, previewed and uploaded; final numbers come from the API, with optional names and per-image attribute overrides.
Observed holders and transfer relationships render; configured rates, transfers and unverified or pending payments do not invent royalty income.

Registering a native payment sends exact price wei, previews 4.29% of 1 as 0.0429, shows only a verified receipt in table/chart, handles the same hash idempotently and never requests a wallet signature or transaction.
Desktop and 390px mobile layouts render without page-level horizontal overflow.
Concurrent expired administrative reads share one session refresh without another wallet signature.
Temporary refresh unavailability preserves the verified panel and recovers without requiring wallet login.
Removing the wallet locks access and clears previous catalog details from the DOM.
A stored transaction hash recovers by confirmation only; reloading and clicking again does not prepare, sign or submit the completed NFT a second time.
Catalog pagination requests the next offset, appends a token with an exact 78-digit invoice ID and removes its load button when all records are present.
A different collection delegate makes NFT and collection editors read-only; attempted form submission makes no mutation and preserves the admin session.
Anonymous startup keeps the catalog locked without requesting wallet signatures.
